tagline: For kids ages 4 to 8: Santa, reindeer, snowmen, trees and more
full_title: Draw Christmas Step by Step: 50 Easy Holiday Drawings for Kids
subtitle: A Fun How-to-Draw Christmas Activity Book for Ages 4 to 8 with Santa, Reindeer, Snowmen, Elves, Gingerbread, Trees and Presents
author: Aadhavan Muthurengan
cover_subtitle: A Fun How-to-Draw Christmas Book for Kids
back_headline: one easy step at a time!
back_lines: Each holiday picture is broken into small, simple steps. The new
lines are black and the lines you already drew are gray, so young
artists always know exactly what to draw next.
• 50 cute, original Christmas pictures in 6 themes
• Santa, reindeer, elves, snowmen, trees, toys and treats
• A big “Your turn!” space on every page
• Warm-up tracing pages and a certificate at the end
• Large 8.5 x 11 in pages: a perfect stocking stuffer
